meta.description: Guarded, headless browser guidance for Cincinnati zoning, business permits and fees, special events, and residential permitting.
meta.author: RUDI
meta.boundary: Guidance only. No account creation, sign-in, terms acceptance, uploads, staff messages, application submission, downloads, or payment.
meta.mcpSafety: Every tool is Cincinnati-scoped and exact-schema. Browser contexts are isolated and closed after each bounded call; resumable anonymous state is encrypted at rest and expires after 24 hours.
